description: Audits vendor artifacts (e.g. a dbt manifest) against the governed CoreModels graph — read-only. Reports coverage (what is/isn't governed, canonical-mapping coverage), drift (fields added/removed/retyped, enum changes, contract flips), and conformance (vendor best-practice rules). errorCount > 0 is the CI-gate fail signal; 'markdown' holds the human-readable report.

artifactUrls.description: Artifact name -> URL to fetch it from (for payloads too large to inline).

artifacts.description: Artifact name -> raw content. dbt: manifest (required), catalog, semantic_manifest.
